# Benford Lens 1.0.1

Benford Lens is a local-first desktop application for exploring first- and second-digit
distributions in CSV and Excel data. Analysis remains on your computer; the application has no
login, telemetry, cloud analysis, update check, or online upload path.

This patch supersedes the private v1.0.0 packages with a reduced, notice-complete third-party
runtime. The analysis methods and explicit user-choice workflow are unchanged.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | `Benford-Lens-1.0.1-windows-x64.msi` | Per-user installation with a Start menu shortcut and standard uninstall |
| Windows x64 | `Benford-Lens-1.0.1-windows-x64.zip` | Portable folder; extract the complete folder before running `benford-lens.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Benford-Lens-1.0.1-macOS-arm64.zip` | Extract, move **Benford Lens** to Applications if desired, and open it |

Each package has a matching `.sha256` file. Verify that checksum before running the download.

## Important platform security notice

These packages are distributed without a paid platform signing identity.

- **Windows:** the executable and MSI are not Authenticode-signed. Microsoft Defender
  SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-app warning, and Smart App Control or an
  organization-managed policy may block the application.
- **macOS:** the app has an ad-hoc integrity signature but is not signed with Apple Developer ID
  and is not notarized. Gatekeeper may require one attempted open followed by
  **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

Only continue when the download came from this repository and its SHA-256 checksum matches. The
project does not ask users to disable antivirus software or system-wide security protections.

## What changed

- Replaced the broad PySide6 metapackage with PySide6 Essentials and removed unused Addons.
- Excluded Qt 6.11 GPL-only modules and added completed-package enforcement.
- Included complete Python, Qt, native-library, font, PyInstaller, and WiX notices.
- Added Qt/PySide source availability and dynamic-library replacement guidance.
- Added a local in-app third-party notice view in all seven interface languages.
- Added contribution, security, support, conduct, issue, and pull-request guidance.
- Pinned GitHub Actions to immutable commits, minimized release token permissions, and added
  dependency/security maintenance workflows.

See the [third-party notices](https://github.com/internalforces/BenfordLens/blob/v1.0.1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md),
[user guide](https://github.com/internalforces/BenfordLens/blob/v1.0.1/docs/user-guide.md), and
[verification guide](https://github.com/internalforces/BenfordLens/blob/v1.0.1/docs/verification.md).
